verdict.rationale: The evidence offers only a general claim of "transparent, upfront pricing—no hidden legal fees" and a personalized "cost breakdown" in the eligibility assessment. Nothing shows a pricing page that itemizes Deel's own fees separately from USCIS filing fees and premium processing. The refund guarantee's mention of "our fees" implies such a distinction but does not document it on any pricing page, so it counts only as adjacent support.

support.subject: As a founder, the provider's pricing pages separate its own fees from USCIS filing fees and premium processing, so the all-in cost is honest
